## Start with the supplied assets

The complete brand kit generates `logos/outlined/original-positive.svg` for vector placement, `logos/png/original-positive-2048.png` for Word-compatible raster placement, and `logos/pdf/original-positive.pdf` for a vector proof. The repository generates these paths from `brands/sparklab/brand.json`.

Focused packs contain selected formats. Check `web/asset-catalog.json` or the package’s `index.html` before using a path; these files list what was actually exported. Word documents embed their logo, while standalone PNG availability depends on the selected pack and rendering options. Choose the **Send to a printer** or **Complete brand kit** pack with graphic PDFs enabled when a separate vector PDF is required.

The preferred logo is the supplied original signature. Keep its proportions. Minimum width: 32 mm. Keep one arrowhead-width clear around the complete logo. The document profile adds 8 mm of layout spacing; the identity clear-space rule remains authoritative.

Artwork provenance: SPARK Lab website, https://sparklab.unbc.ca/: original SVG artwork, theme palette, Outfit and Source Serif 4. Applications and motion developed for brandkit.

## Document styles

The examples support US Letter and A4. This profile uses US Letter (215.9 × 279.4 mm), with 18/18/18/18 mm top/right/bottom/left margins. Text and tables remain editable in Word. The printable HTML uses the same content model.

| Style | Family | Weight | Size | Line height |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| title | Outfit | 600 | 30 pt | 1.12 |
| heading1 | Outfit | 600 | 22 pt | 1.2 |
| body | Source Serif 4 | 400 | 10.5 pt | 1.45 |
| caption | Outfit | 500 | 8.5 pt | 1.35 |
| table | Source Serif 4 | 400 | 9.5 pt | 1.3 |

Install the supplied fonts before editing outside the kit. The existing Word exporter embeds eligible fonts; a face with an explicit Office substitution uses that declared installed face. Font files and their licences remain in the kit.

Use the light paper and ink roles for document pages; retain the brand’s own typefaces and logo proportions.

Document colours: ink #122738; muted #3A4F63; accent #122738; paper #FAF8F5; lines #E8EEF4.

## Screenshots and figures

Keep application colours and legible interface text. Use actual captures; label placeholders, mockups and diagrams explicitly. Explain the visible action or result. Record source, capture date and context when relevant. Crop to the relevant region without hiding information needed to interpret the image. Verify labels at the final printed size. A screenshot placeholder is not evidence of a working feature.

## Write for the document purpose

- **Product overview:** Explain an offering and its supported scope without implying previous client delivery.
- **Project report:** Present findings, their evidence, decisions and follow-up work.
- **Decision brief:** Explain the decision needed, compare options and identify the next step.

Describe verified capabilities. Do not imply client delivery, endorsement, results or compatibility without supporting evidence. Include contact details only when explicitly supplied. Do not use a template placeholder as a real contact. Product copy describes an offering; case-study language requires evidence of the work described. Historical identity examples keep their reconstruction and modern-layout labels.

## Six reusable layouts

- **Cover:** Brand artwork, title, scope and edition.
- **Content:** A clear summary, explanatory paragraphs and a short list.
- **Product detail:** Audience, purpose, workflow and supported scope.
- **Screenshot or evidence:** A real capture or clearly labelled placeholder, with an explanatory caption.
- **Comparison:** Options or capabilities compared against the same criteria.
- **Closing:** Next steps, supplied contact details and source status.

The sample model contains instructional content and a labelled screenshot placeholder. Replace its content through `publicationModel(brand, { paper, purpose, values })`, or edit the exported publication JSON. Keep this source model alongside the editable Word master and shared PDF.

## Supported edit path

In this repository, edit the generator inputs and rerun the listed command; direct changes to the generated brand.json may be overwritten. In an exported standalone kit, source/brand.json is the editable definition.

Repository generator inputs: `scripts/brands/sparklab.mjs`. Rebuild with `npm run make:sparklab`.

Optional brand.documentation changes document applications only. Persist repository overrides in the brand generator; keep publication content in its own source model.

Regenerate these use guides with `node scripts/brands/documentation.mjs`. Keep headings, body text, captions and tables editable. Recheck pagination after changing content or fonts. Check every final page after changing fonts, images, tables or content. The output from one format does not by itself verify the other.
